entries.RULES.admission.pen: Members may invite people to join the membership at will ✒️.

entries.page.ask.mostGenerous: The most generous you will accept
entries.page.ask.mostOpen: The most open you will accept
entries.page.binPutBack: Put it back as it stands
entries.page.cards.admission.rule: Each member says the cheapest admission they would accept, and the document takes the dearest — one member who wants everyone asked keeps everyone asked.
entries.page.cards.applications.rule: Each member says the most open door they would accept, and the document takes the least open of them — one member who wants invitation only keeps it so.
entries.page.cards.authorship.rule: This one is about privacy, so it runs the other way: the document takes the most private answer, and one member who wants to stay unnamed keeps everybody unnamed.
entries.page.cards.authorship.takes: The document takes the most private
entries.page.cards.bar.rule: Each member says the lowest they will accept, and the document takes the highest — so it is never easier to change than any one of them wanted.
entries.page.cards.chamber.rule: This one is about privacy, so the most private answer wins: one member who wants it kept closed keeps it closed.
entries.page.cards.chamber.takes: The document takes the most private
entries.page.cards.ending.routeNote: What this takes depends on what you write. A different date is a proposal ✏️ like any other. Never — no end date at all — needs every member to agree, because with no end date the approval threshold cannot rise, and every change made so far was made under one that did.
entries.page.cards.ending.rule: Each member says when they want it to end, and the document takes the latest answer — never being later than any date — so nobody is cut off before they were ready.
entries.page.cards.judgments.rule: Also about privacy, so the most private answer wins: one member who wants them kept private keeps them private.
entries.page.cards.judgments.takes: The document takes the most private
entries.page.cards.lapse.rule: Each member says the shortest gap they would accept, and the document takes the longest — never being longer than any of them — so nobody loses their membership faster than they accepted.
entries.page.cards.quorum.rule: Each member says the lowest they will accept, and the document takes the highest.
entries.page.cards.rate.rule: Each member says the most generous they would accept, and the document takes it.
entries.page.cards.rate.takes: The document takes the most generous
entries.page.cards.removal.rule: Each member says the easiest they would accept, and the document takes the hardest — one member who wants everybody asked keeps everybody asked.
entries.page.cards.shape.t: What Type of Document Is This?
entries.page.clerkNoPencil: You are not a member, so there is no ✏️ for you to spend — this one is yours to set.
entries.page.composeNote.inviteConstitutional: An invitation is constitutional, because the membership is what quorum is a fraction of: all members must agree, and one who says no keeps them out.
entries.page.composeNote.neverNeedsAll: Taking the end date away needs all members to agree — with no end date the approval threshold cannot rise.
entries.page.composeNote.oneMotionOneRule: One motion proposes one rule; what you do not touch stands.
entries.page.composeNote.redirect: Every link the document has ever had keeps working — a change leaves a redirect behind.
entries.page.composeNote.removalSeen: Whoever it is will see the proposal — nobody is removed in secret.
entries.page.consent.honour: Proposals keep the privacy they were made under.
entries.page.consent.inviteAbstain.1: An answer, not a block: they can join without your consent counting either way.
entries.page.consent.inviteNo.0: I would rather they did not
entries.page.consent.inviteNo.1: They stay out. Nobody is told who said so.
entries.page.consent.inviteWhy: ƒ (name) => 'Whether ' + name + ' joins the membership. Adding a member changes what quorum is a fraction of, so it is constitutional: the most restrictive answer wins, and one member who says no keeps them out.'
entries.page.consent.inviteYes.1: They start with the ✏️s everyone got, plus what the drip has added since, and quorum recomputes.
entries.page.consent.removeByAll: and their own answer counts among everyone’s.
entries.page.consent.removeByOthers: decided by everyone but them; they see it running.
entries.page.consent.removeNo.1: Nobody is told who said so.
entries.page.consent.removeSelfCount: ƒ (judged, others) => judged + ' of ' + others + ' have answered. One refusal keeps you in.'
entries.page.consent.removeSelfWhy: Whether you leave the membership. Under this document’s rule that is decided by everyone but you — you see it running, and your answer is not asked.
entries.page.consent.removeWhy: ƒ (name) => 'Whether ' + name + ' leaves the membership. Removing a member changes what quorum is a fraction of, so it is constitutional — '
entries.page.consent.removeYes.1: Their votes already cast keep counting; quorum recomputes.
entries.page.consent.setAbstain.1: An answer, not a block: the motion can pass without your consent counting either way.
entries.page.consent.setNo.1: Nobody is told who said so.
entries.page.consent.setWhy: ƒ (to, stands) => 'Whether ' + to + ' replaces ' + stands + '. There is no vote here: you state what you will accept, and one refusal keeps what stands.'
entries.page.consent.setYes: ƒ (e) => ['I accept the change', 'It passes once all ' + e + ' stand at accept — or abstain.']
entries.page.crownHand: The founder’s own hand — a Founder Action ✒️, not a proposal
entries.page.departed.byFounder: ƒ (day) => 'The Founder removed you from this document on ' + day + '.'
entries.page.departed.byMembers: ƒ (day) => 'The membership removed you from this document on ' + day + '.'
entries.page.departed.bySelf: ƒ (day) => 'You left this document on ' + day + '.'
entries.page.departed.lineFounder: ƒ (who, day) => 'The Founder removed ' + who + ' on ' + day + '.'
entries.page.departed.lineMembers: ƒ (who, day) => 'The membership removed ' + who + ' on ' + day + '.'
entries.page.departed.lineSelf: ƒ (who, day) => who + ' left on ' + day + '.'
entries.page.founderMark.crowned: Part of the constitution is reserved: changing it needs the founder’s assent
entries.page.founderMark.none: The Founder reserves nothing — no special part in the document
entries.page.gate.begin.title: Begin
entries.page.gate.canjudge.title: Voting

entries.page.gate.canpropose.done: Open — members can propose as soon as they arrive.
entries.page.gate.canpropose.title: Proposals

entries.page.gate.closing.title: The Close

entries.page.gate.shield.title: Founder Veto
entries.page.gate.shield.why: As the founder of this document, you have the power to veto choices that the membership make. Founder Veto is denoted by 🛡️. You can later give up this power if you choose to.
entries.page.gate.voice.title: Constitutional Proposals

entries.page.nothingToPut: That could not be proposed: nothing is chosen on this card.
entries.page.penWait: Founder Actions ✒️ are waiting in your tasks — accept them and this turns.
entries.page.preamble.beforeBegin: When the document begins, members may propose changes to rules and vote on proposals.
entries.page.preamble.onceAnswered: once they have answered the questions the Founder delegated
entries.page.preamble.passConstitutional: A constitutional proposal 🏛️ passes only when all members agree.
entries.page.preamble.passOrdinary: A proposal ✏️ passes when it meets the approval threshold.

entries.page.preamble.proposeLead: Members may propose changes to rules

entries.page.preamble.voteWhenDecided: Members may begin voting on proposals when the whole constitution has been decided.

        ' may ' + parts.join(', and ') + '.'

entries.page.pw.notes.atBeginTail: It takes effect when the document begins.
entries.page.pw.notes.delegatesTail: Neither power would be left, so it hands the question to the membership straight away.
entries.page.pw.notes.given: Given up. The road back is a constitutional motion, the members’ to move.
entries.page.pw.notes.givenFromStart: Given up from the start. The Founder holds it until the document begins.
entries.page.pw.notes.givenOneWay: Given up — one way. The road back is the members’ reserve motion.
entries.page.pw.notes.holds: The Founder holds this. Giving it up is the Founder’s, one way; taking a held power from them is a constitutional motion, the members’ to move.
entries.page.pw.notes.oneWayTail: One way — the road back is the members’ to give.
entries.page.pw.notes.opensWithValue: Opens once this setting has a value.
entries.page.pw.notes.revisable: Revisable until the document begins. Giving both up hands the question to the members — delegation is exactly the state of holding neither.
entries.page.pw.notes.vetoNeedsPen: A veto can only be held where the Founder still amends it at will — take back the ✒️ first.
entries.page.pw.noun.title: the title
entries.page.pw.opts.invite.a.given.1: An invitation the membership passes needs nobody’s assent.
entries.page.pw.opts.invite.a.held.1: Each invitation, and each application, comes as a 👑 question — assent or refuse.
entries.page.pw.opts.invite.u.given.0: Only as Admissions says, like anybody.
entries.page.pw.opts.invite.u.given.1: The Founder proposes a member like anybody, at the price the document sets.
entries.page.pw.opts.invite.u.held.1: Nobody else has to agree when the Founder brings somebody in.

entries.page.pw.opts.remove.a.held.1: Each removal comes as a 👑 question — assent or refuse.
entries.page.pw.opts.remove.u.given.0: Only as Removal says, like anybody.
entries.page.pw.opts.remove.u.given.1: The Founder proposes a removal like anybody, at the price the document sets.
entries.page.pw.opts.remove.u.held.1: A member the Founder removes is gone at once — nobody else has to agree.
entries.page.pw.opts.star.a.held.1: Each one comes as a 👑 question — assent or refuse.
entries.page.pw.opts.star.u.given.1: The Founder proposes like a member.
entries.page.pw.opts.star.u.held.0: The Founder changes it at will.
entries.page.pw.opts.star.u.held.1: No proposal needed for the Founder’s own hand.

entries.page.pw.opts.text.u.given.1: The Founder proposes a change to the text like a member.
entries.page.pw.opts.text.u.held.0: The Founder edits the text at will.
